create.name: Mimi Kuo-Deemer
create.bio:
Mimi Kuo-Deemer teaches qigong, Buddhist meditation and the internal martial arts of Baguazhang and Xingyiquan from her home in the Oxfordshire countryside. American by birth, she studied at Stanford and then spent well over a decade in Beijing, working as a photographer and helping to start one of the city's first yoga studios. Her qigong took root during those years in China. She was later accepted as a disciple in the Liu Fengchun line of Baguazhang, which makes her a sixth-generation lineage holder, and Martin Aylward has authorised her to teach Insight Meditation. She also holds a master's degree from SOAS on the yoga and meditation traditions.

Her classes pair slow, flowing forms with Daoist and Buddhist thinking about nature, the seasons and the Five Phases, and she keeps the mood playful as well as exact. Most weekly classes run live on Zoom on a donation basis, backed by a library of recorded series; she also leads residential retreats in England, France and at Omega in New York, mentors new qigong teachers, and has free and paid courses on Commune. Her two books, Xiu Yang and Qigong and the Tai Chi Axis, were published by Orion Spring in the UK.

books.title: Qigong and the Tai Chi Axis
books.author: Mimi Kuo-Deemer
books.description: An illustrated practice book that moves through the five elements and their matching seasons, with qigong sequences for each one. Alongside the forms she explains the Daoist ideas behind them and how the practice can steady both body and mood through the year.

books.title: Xiu Yang
books.author: Mimi Kuo-Deemer
books.description: A short guide to the Chinese idea of self-cultivation, drawing on Daoist and Confucian sources and her own years living in China. Each chapter pairs a theme with reflections and simple practices for bringing more care and balance into daily life.

courses.title: Mindful Dragon Qigong
courses.description: A six-day residential workshop at Omega's Rhinebeck campus built around qigong's spiralling dragon forms. Each day mixes movement practice with talks and sitting and standing meditation drawn from the Buddhist teachings she has followed for years. Open to all levels.

courses.title: Qigong and the Five Phases (Wuxing)
courses.description: A five-week online programme on Commune of about 25 hours, combining filmed lessons with weekly live calls. It works through Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water in turn, teaching the forms, breathing and Daoist background for each.

courses.title: Internal Martial Arts Retreat in the Cotswolds
courses.description: A five-day residential gathering at a country house in the Cotswolds to train Golden Bell qigong alongside Baguazhang and Xingyiquan. It is for students who have already completed the first two seasons of her online internal martial arts course.

courses.title: Earth Below, Sky Above, Heart at Centre
courses.description: A week-long silent meditation and qigong retreat at Moulin de Chaves near Bordeaux, co-taught with Martin Aylward. Days include early qigong, meditation instruction, a work period and evening dharma talks; booking is handled by the retreat centre and opens in January 2027.

courses.title: An Introduction to Qigong: Practice and Principles - A 6 Week Course
courses.description: A recorded six-week beginners' series, first taught live on Zoom. It covers basic stances, warm-ups and short sequences together with the main ideas that underpin qigong.

courses.title: The 8 Silk Brocades - A 6 Week Course
courses.description: Six recorded classes that build up the Eight Brocades sequence one movement at a time. Students can stream or download the sessions and practise at their own pace.

courses.title: Qigong Breathing, Visualisations & Meditation
courses.description: A four-week recorded course on the quieter side of qigong. Each week adds a breathing method or visualisation and finishes in seated meditation.

courses.title: The Art of Residing in Radiance - A Series of 5 Classes
courses.description: Five recorded classes teaching a flowing qigong set with a contemplative, light-filled theme. Suited to students who already know the basics and want a longer form to practise.

free_resources.title: Mindful Dragon Qigong with Mimi Kuo-Deemer (Free Pass)
free_resources.description: A free five-part course on Commune that sets dragon-inspired qigong forms beside short mindfulness practices from the Buddhist tradition. A good taster for her Omega workshop of the same name.

free_resources.title: Qigong: The Five Sacred Guardians with Mimi Kuo-Deemer (Free Pass)
free_resources.description: A free Commune course built around five guardian animals from Chinese star lore: dragon, bird, snake, tiger and tortoise. Each lesson links a form and a meditation to the quality that animal stands for.

free_resources.title: Qigong: The 18 Forms with Mimi Kuo-Deemer (Free Pass)
free_resources.description: Six days of short lessons on the classic Shibashi sequence, offered free on Commune. Gentle enough for any age or level of fitness.

free_resources.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades with Mimi Kuo-Deemer (Free Pass)
free_resources.description: A free five-day Commune course teaching the traditional Eight Brocades along with the philosophy behind each movement.

free_resources.title: Open Qigong Class: Fire & The Summer Practice
free_resources.description: A full recorded class of just over an hour on her YouTube channel, working with the Fire phase and the energy of summer through movement and stillness.

flags: She also teaches several qigong courses on Commune (onecommune.com): one paid course and four free passes are listed here. Commune is not yet a Spiritpedia hub, so no teaches_at link was added; worth linking if Commune becomes a hub.

Email enquiries@mkdeemer.com is Cloudflare-obfuscated in the visible page text (self-paced courses page, also the 2027 teacher-training page) and decoded; the contact page itself is a form (https://www.mkdeemer.com/contact.html).
City set to Stonesfield, Oxfordshire: her teacher-training modules meet at Stonesfield Village Hall and her published mailing address is there; she describes home as the Oxfordshire countryside.
Commune course price is not shown as a figure; the page says it is included in Commune membership with a 14-day free trial.
The Cotswolds internal martial arts retreat is only open to students who have finished Seasons One and Two of her online course; twin and camping places are fully booked.
The Commune free passes need an email sign-up on Commune to start.
